executive_summary:
The cyber threat climate remains ELEVATED day-over-day, characterized by significant vulnerability disclosures across enterprise systems and middle-tier infrastructure. Newly surfaced vulnerabilities include an OS command injection flaw in Collabora Online Built-in CODE Server (CVE-2026-110447, EPSS 1.23%, 68.6th percentile) and a SQL injection weakness in Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator (CVE-2026-114625). While active exploitation in the wild remains unverified for today's new disclosures, the presence of critical command injection vectors highlights the immediate necessity for applying vendor updates and ensuring compliance with CISA BOD 26-04 directives.

In artificial intelligence, open-weights model development and red-teaming methodologies saw significant progress. DeepSeek released DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, generating substantial community adoption, while Black Forest Labs expanded image generation capabilities with flux-3-image-klein-comfy. On the research front, frameworks like LLM-Attacker and EvalResearchBench introduced novel approaches to privacy red-teaming in split LLMs and autonomous evaluation generation for recursive self-improvement.

Developer tooling trends emphasize alternative operating environments and reverse-engineering capabilities, as seen in projects like free-my-tv and fairplay-decrypt. Simultaneously, major tech headlines centered around the launch of Moonshot AI's Kimi K3.1 Pro model suite, public security research detailing iOS exploit chains, and ongoing civil liberties debates concerning Canada's Bill C-22 surveillance proposal.
key_takeaways: NEW: Collabora CODE Server (CVE-2026-110447) and Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator (CVE-2026-114625) face high-severity vulnerability disclosures requiring urgent remediation under CISA BOD 26-04.
NEW: DeepSeek introduced DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 alongside new research on split LLM red-teaming (LLM-Attacker) and recursive self-improvement evaluation (EvalResearchBench).
NEW: Open-source developer momentum centers on hardware modification and DRM decryption with tools such as EthanArbuckle/fairplay-decrypt and simbasjungles/free-my-tv.
NEW: Industry news highlights Moonshot AI's release of Kimi K3.1 Pro and public security findings on iPhone vulnerability exploitation.

cves.title: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator SQL Injection Vulnerability
cves.description: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator on-prem contains a SQL injection vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
cves.remediation: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions and comply with CISA BOD 26-04 guidance.

cves.title: Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server OS Command Injection Vulnerability
cves.description: Collabora Online Built-in CODE Server when used within the NextCloud platform contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows remote code execution when the CODE server is not running.
cves.remediation: Update CODE Server immediately according to Nextcloud and Collabora security advisories.

cves.title: EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition OS Command Injection Vulnerability
cves.description: EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition contains an OS command injection vulnerability allowing an attacker to execute arbitrary OS commands with root or SYSTEM privileges.
cves.remediation: Apply vendor updates following official alert instructions.

cves.title: Plex Media Server External Control of File Name or Path Vulnerability
cves.description: Plex Media Server contains an external control of file name or path vulnerability enabling an admin user to write arbitrary files executable on load. Can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96655.
cves.remediation: Upgrade Plex Media Server to version 1.43.3 or later.

cves.title: Plex Media Server Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
cves.description: Plex Media Server contains an SSRF vulnerability allowing authenticated users to request arbitrary internal or external addresses via the transcode universal endpoint.
cves.remediation: Upgrade Plex Media Server to version 1.43.3 or later.
